title: Compliance status validity period is longer than recommended

maxDays.text: Days a device may go without reporting before it is marked non-compliant

messages.businessImpact: A device that stopped reporting keeps its compliant status, and its access, for {Facts.Tenant.ComplianceCheckinThresholdDays} days. A laptop lost or stolen today would retain access for most of that period.
remediation: Reduce the compliance status validity period to 30 days or fewer.
Pair it with a stale device cleanup rule so silent devices are removed rather than left in place.
messages.cannotSee: The period is read as configured. How many devices are actually stale, and so how much of the estate the period is currently protecting, is not visible from it.
